title: Skill Pack
description: Platform knowledge, tools and checks that plug into a role (usually Developer, QA or DevOps) for tasks on one platform.

platform.description: Matched against task.platform to select this pack.

applies_to.description: Role ids that can load this pack.

requirements.description: Host requirements checked before the pack loads. The task fails fast if any is missing.

below_version.description: Version must be lower than this, e.g. a tool release that breaks the build.

env.description: Env var names that must be set (values never stored here).

instructions.description: Path to the pack's prompt additions (Markdown), appended to the role's instructions.

variables.description: Settings the pack needs, referenced as ${pack.<name>}. scope=project values come from the project config (e.g. Xcode scheme); scope=task values come from each task's pack_variables (e.g. which Mule app to build).

tools.description: Command tools the pack adds. Each becomes a callable tool for the agent.

command.description: Command template, split into arguments like a shell would but never run through one. May use ${pack.*}, ${platform.*}, ${project.*}, ${task.*} and ${args.*}; each ${args.*} fills exactly one argument.

pattern.description: Regex the value must match (guards against injection).

verification.description: Deterministic checks. The Developer runs them before opening a PR; QA reruns them independently and records results in the test report.

blocking.description: If true, a failure sends the task back to the Developer.

output_must_not_match.description: Regex; a match counts as failure even with exit code 0.

artifacts.description: Globs to attach to the test report (logs, screenshots, .xcresult).

permissions.description: Permissions the pack REQUESTS. Effective = this ∩ role ceiling.
